description: A residue guard is index information: intersecting i % 2 == 1 with 1 <= i <= 2 leaves the single value 1, which a length floor of one already covers, so the element read publishes presence. The intersection is the whole proof, so a residue class that still leaves a value above the floor, or a range with no residue guard at all, leaves the read optional.

facts.name: the residue-pinned read is proven present
facts.subject: xs

facts.name: a residue class above the floor proves nothing
facts.subject: zs

facts.name: a range without a residue guard proves nothing
facts.subject: ws
